newsitem.title: USA: Search abandoned for yacht crew lost off Florida.
newsitem.headline: Search abandoned for yacht crew lost off Florida.

text.p: The U.S. Coast Guard gave up the search on Monday for 16 people who went missing after reporting on Sunday night they were abandoning their sinking yacht off Fort Pierce, Florida, a Coast Guard spokesman said.
The Coast Guard said the crew of the Intrepid, a 65-foot (22-metre) sailboat, sent out a distress call saying it was sinking and everyone on board was escaping on a life raft.
They had no information of the yacht's home port or nationality of the crew.

Coast Guard Lt. Robert Engle said the search -- involving two helicopters and a cutter -- was suspended late on Monday afternoon, after crews had searched 6,000 square miles (15,500 sq km) of water about 30 miles (48 km) off Fort Pierce, on Florida's east coast north of Palm Beach.
"We feel if they were out there, we would have found them," said Engle.
The Coast Guard said seas in the area were rough with waves up to 7 feet (2 metres) high.
